AI Agent Olympics Hackathon

The Official Hackathon at Milan AI Week 2026

⏱️ Build the next generation of Autonomous Agents in the heart of Europe’s AI Revolution.


📅 May 13 – 20, 2026

May 13 – 19: Online Build Phase.

May 19: An exclusive on-site build day at Milan AI Week for selected participants.

May 20: Awards Ceremony.


📍On-site Venue (May 19–20):

Fiera Milano (Rho), Milan, Italy


🤝 Join solo or with a team.


🎟 FREE Milan AI Week conference ticket included for participants.


💰 $32,000+ prize pool


🧑‍💻 Apply now to turn your autonomous agent into a market-ready enterprise solution.

About

AI WEEK brings together over 700 international speakers, 250+ AI Exhibitors and 25,000 +attendees across 10 stages, uniting managers, entrepreneurs, engineers, researchers, and innovators shaping the future of technology.

Through keynotes, masterclasses, and real-world case studies, the event explores how AI is redefining competitiveness, sustainability, and global enterprise.


🎟 FREE Milan AI Week conference ticket included for participants.


Hosted during AI WEEK, Europe’s largest event dedicated to Artificial Intelligence — The AI Agent Olympics Hackathon transforms conversation into creation.


Media & Community partners

Challenge

Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that move beyond copilots — into real decision-making systems that create measurable enterprise value.


Choose a track that matches your vision:

  • 🧠 Intelligent Reasoning Use advanced reasoning to analyze inputs and make independent decisions. Your agent should be able to handle roadblocks and change its plan without human intervention.


  • 🔄 Agentic Workflows Design workflows where the agent plans its own steps, calls external tools (APIs, databases, or browsers), and manages multi-step tasks over time.


🌍 Enterprise Utility Solve a real-world friction point for the managers and entrepreneurs at AI Week.


  • 🧩 Multimodal Intelligence Leverage the ability to process images, documents, audio, or video to unlock richer interactions— such as analyzing business reports or physical environment data. 


  • 🤝 Collaborative Systems Build a multi-agent system where different specialized agents coordinate and share information to achieve a high-level goal that a single LLM couldn't handle alone. 

Your mission is to build and launch an AI-native product using X402 Payments - a programmable payments infrastructure designed for the next generation of agentic and automated economies.


In this edition of Launch & Fund Your Startup, you’ll have 6 days to validate an idea, build a working prototype, and present a credible path toward real users and on-chain revenue.

This challenge is open to everyone - from early-stage founders to existing startups looking to expand or pivot their products.


Your submission should clearly show how your solution integrates or reimagines X402 Payments in the context of real-world financial interaction


Tracks
Choose one - or mix and match. Each track explores a core use case of programmable payments in the age of agentic systems:


🤖 Agent-to-Agent Payments

Challenge: Build a system where two or more agents autonomously trigger and settle payments—e.g., for usage-based services, access control, or dynamic pricing. Your product should demonstrate a working agentic payment loop with minimal human input.



🧑‍💼Consumer AI Payments

Challenge: Develop an AI assistant that can make payments on a user’s behalf—with built-in rules like spending limits, approval checkpoints, or identity verification (KYC/AML). Showcase how your product handles decision-making, compliance, and safeguards.



🏢 B2B FinOps & Compliance

Challenge: Build a tool for businesses to manage real-time payments and financial operations—like tracking cash flow, enforcing policies, or generating audit-ready records. Highlight automation, accuracy, and visibility into payment activity.



🛒 On-chain Commerce Primitives

Challenge: Launch a digital product or service with a built-in revenue model using X402. Think: token-gated access, real-time rev-splits, or instant payouts to contributors. Your prototype should demonstrate seamless, trustless commerce flows.

Vultr powers the backend infrastructure for this hackathon.

Teams that deploy on Vultr and use it as the central system of record for planning, coordination, and execution will be eligible for the Vultr Awards.


Challenge:

Build a Web-Based Enterprise Agent Deployed on Vultr

Design and develop a web-based AI agent built for real-world enterprise workflows across operations, sales, marketing, customer support, HR, and beyond.

Projects should demonstrate multi-step agentic workflows, realistic future-of-work use cases, and a production-style web application.


Developer Expectations

Each team must provide:

  • ✅ GitHub repository with setup and documentation
  • ✅ Vultr VM backend deployment
  • ✅ Public demo URL
  • ✅ Recorded demo video
  • • Clear explanation of architecture and use case

Technology

  • • Use any programming language or framework
  • • Use open-source LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation workflows
  • • Vultr Serverless Inference is available for eligible projects

⚠️ Note: Vultr GPUs are not available for this event.

Gemini is Google’s family of next-generation multimodal AI models capable of reasoning across text, images, code, video, and audio.

Google AI Studio is a browser-based environment where developers can easily prototype, test, and iterate with Gemini models before integrating them into production using the Gemini API.


Challenge:

Build intelligent agents or applications using Gemini models and Google AI Studio.

Your project should:

  • • Use Gemini via Google AI Studio or the Gemini API for reasoning, chat, or multimodal understanding
  • • Implement agent-driven or automated workflows that respond to user input, data, or context
  • • Demonstrate practical value through a working prototype or intelligent system

Recommended Gemini Models:

Participants are encouraged to select the Gemini model that best fits their agent use case:

  • • Gemini Flash: Optimized for speed and low latency. Ideal for real-time applications and responsive agent workflows.
  • • Gemini Pro: Designed for advanced reasoning and complex decision-making across multi-step workflows.

Example Use Cases:

  • • AI copilots and enterprise assistants
  • • Agentic commerce and workflow automation
  • • Multimodal applications using text, image, audio, or video understanding
  • • Research, analysis, and decision-support systems
  • • Customer support and conversational AI experiences

Access to Technology:

Participants can explore Gemini through two main options, both including free access.

  • • Google AI Studio: A browser-based IDE for experimenting with Gemini models without API setup or billing.
  • • Gemini API: Includes a free monthly allowance for text and multimodal inputs/outputs.

🔓 $300 in free Google Cloud credits are available for new Google Cloud accounts and valid for 90 days.

Credits can be used across eligible Google Cloud services, including Gemini API usage.

🔘 Learn More About Google Cloud Free Tier

🚀 How to Get Started:

  1. 1. Visit the Gemini docs
  2. 2. Follow the Quickstart Guide to explore Gemini in AI Studio
  3. 3. Experiment with multimodal prompts
  4. 4. Build and test your agent or application

Kraken is one of the most established cryptocurrency exchanges in the world, trusted by institutions and individual traders, and known for its deep liquidity and trading infrastructure.

For this hackathon, participants will work with two Kraken products:

  • • Kraken CLI is an AI-native command-line interface for programmatic trading. It handles exchange complexity such as authentication, rate limiting, and order management so you can focus on your agent’s strategy logic.
  • • xStocks are 1:1 asset-backed tokenized U.S. equities and ETFs that can be traded 24/7 on-chain.

Challenge:

Build an autonomous AI agent that trades xStocks, tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, using the Kraken CLI as its execution layer.

Your agent should analyze market signals, form a strategy, and execute trades programmatically without manual intervention. This could include a momentum-based stock picker, portfolio rebalancer, or event-driven trading system.


✅ How Agents Are Ranked:

Agents in the Kraken Challenge are evaluated across two independent categories.

1️⃣ Trading Performance (PnL)

Agents are ranked purely by net PnL, realized plus unrealized, over the competition period.

How it works:

  • • Submission: Each participant provides a read-only Kraken API key linked to their trading account. This allows lablab.ai and Kraken to view trade history. No execution or withdrawal access is granted.
  • • Audit: Kraken performs a final audit on top agents before prizes are distributed.
  • • Ranking: Winners are determined solely by net PnL at the end of the competition window. 

Requirements:

  • • Agents must use Kraken CLI as the execution layer
  • • One submission per participant or team


2️⃣ Social Engagement

Build in public. Share your journey. Inspire the community.

Over a 30-day window, participants earn a Social Engagement Score based purely on quantitative metrics from public platforms, including Twitter/X, YouTube, blogs, or other channels.


How winners are determined:

  • • lablab.ai tracks engagement metrics such as impressions, likes, shares, and reach across linked social accounts
  • • Rankings are determined purely by quantitative data with no subjective judging
  • • Participants can monitor their position throughout the competition window

🚀 How to Get Started

1. Install the Kraken CLI from the official repository

2. Configure your Kraken API access and connect it to your agent

3. Ensure you have access to the xStocks market 

4.  Build an autonomous AI trading agent that analyzes signals and trades xStocks through Kraken CLI  

5. Share your progress publicly as part of the Social Engagement challenge

Featherless provides serverless inference for 27,000+ open-source models through a single OpenAI-compatible API, with no GPU management. It enables developers to build and deploy specialized AI agents quickly and efficiently.


Challenge:

Build a domain-specialized, open-source AI agent using models from the Featherless catalog.

Instead of building general-purpose assistants, focus on creating an agent that performs one task exceptionally well within a specific domain.


What We’re Looking For:

  • • Domain-Specialized, Not Generalist: Choose a real-world domain such as legal, medical, logistics, finance, research, code review, content moderation, or localization.
  • • Async-First Architecture: Build agents that operate in the background, such as scheduled workflows, document pipelines, monitoring systems, or event-driven tasks.
  • • Fully Open-Source: Release your agent under a permissive license such as MIT or Apache 2.0, with prompts, orchestration, and deployment reproducible.
  • • Production-Shaped: Build something deployable, well-documented, and usable beyond the hackathon.

Access to Technology:

Featherless will provide $25 in credits per participant, available to up to 1,000 participants on a first-come, first-served basis. Access is valid for 1 month from activation.

👉 To activate your access, follow the setup guide below:

🔘 Open Featherless Setup Guide (Includes QR & Free Access)

🚀 How to Get Started with Featherless:

  1. 1. Open the setup guide using the link above
  2. 2. Scan the QR code or follow the signup link inside the guide
  3. 3. Create your account and activate your free Premium access
  4. 4. Generate your API key from your account dashboard
  5. 5. Choose a model from the catalog and start building

📘 Resources:

  • • Featherless Platform Overview
  • • Featherless Documentation
  • • Featherless Quickstart

Speechmatics provides highly accurate speech-to-text and conversational AI technology built for AI agents, voice applications, assistants, and real-time workflows.

For this hackathon, participants are encouraged to build AI systems powered by real-time speech understanding using Speechmatics APIs.


Challenge:

Build conversational AI applications, voice-powered agents, or real-time AI systems using Speechmatics speech-to-text technology.

Speechmatics is especially interested in projects leveraging real-time transcription APIs within AI agent workflows, assistants, collaboration tools, accessibility tools, healthcare, customer support, and other voice-first experiences.

Participants are encouraged to build projects involving:

  • • Real-time conversational AI agents
  • • Voice-powered copilots and assistants
  • • AI meeting, interview, or call summarization tools
  • • Speaker diarization and multi-speaker workflows
  • • Accessibility and transcription platforms
  • • Voice interfaces integrated into AI agents or applications

Technology:

Speechmatics provides highly accurate real-time speech-to-text APIs designed for conversational AI, live transcription, and production-grade voice applications.

Key capabilities include:

  • • Real-time transcription APIs optimized for conversational AI and live applications
  • • Speaker diarization for multi-speaker conversations and meeting workflows
  • • Batch transcription support for uploaded audio and recordings
  • • Developer-ready APIs and examples with documentation, SDKs, and GitHub resources
  • • Built for AI agents and conversational workflows requiring accurate speech understanding

Access to Technology:

Speechmatics will provide $200 in API credits per participant, available to the first 200 participants on a first-come, first-served basis. Access is valid for 1 month.

👉 To activate your access, follow the setup guide below:

🔘 Open Speechmatics Setup Guide

Participants will:

  1. 1. Create a Speechmatics account
  2. 2. Add a payment card to activate the account
  3. 3. Redeem the hackathon coupon code
  4. 4. Generate an API key and start building

🎥 A step-by-step credit redemption tutorial video can be found in the Workshop section below.


📘 Resources:

  • • Speechmatics Platform
  • • Speechmatics Documentation
  • • Speechmatics GitHub
  • • Speechmatics Academy

⚠️ Access & Usage Notes
• Vultr: Vultr credits are valid for 30 days during the hackathon. Teams that wish to continue using their infrastructure after the credit period must link a valid payment method to keep their resources active.
• Google Cloud: After free credits expire, continued usage of billable Google Cloud services requires enabling billing on your account. Charges only apply if you choose to continue using paid services.
• Featherless: Feather Premium access is valid for 1 month from activation. Access is provided directly by Featherless and subject to their terms and availability.
• Speechmatics: Credits are provided directly by Speechmatics and subject to their terms and availability. Participants should delete unused API keys after the hackathon to avoid accidental usage charges. The coupon code will only be shared during the kick-off stream.
• General: lablab.ai is not responsible for access provisioning, billing, or third-party platform usage limitations.

Hackathon Details

Join lablab.ai hackathon and innovate using the latest models in the market. Discover all the relevant details below.

🗓️ Where and when

The start date of the hackathon is mentioned according to the date specified on the hackathon page, cover and schedule. The hackathon will take place on the lablab.ai platform and lablab.ai Discord server.

🦸🏼‍♂️ Who can join?

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of previous AI or coding experience! We encourage anyone with a passion for AI or an interest in exploring how it can be used in their field to join.

😅 What about teams?

If you don't have a team, don't worry! You can connect with other participants from all over the world on our dashboard or Discord server. We also recommend checking out our Discord server to find teammates and bounce around ideas. You can join the server here.

🛠️ How to participate

The hackathon will take place online on lablab.ai platform and lablab.ai Discord Server. Please register for both in order to participate. To participate click the "Enroll" button at the bottom of the page and read our Hackathon Guidelines and Getting Started Guide.

🧠 Get prepared / Use Lablab.ai to Learn About AI

To get ready for the hackathon, visit our AI Tech pages and read up on all the available technologies. You can also check out our tutorials page for more information on how to use them. Get a head start on your project by using the resources on lablab.ai!
